artworks.title: The Fall of the Giants
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed on 4 sheets joined together
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing mythological figures in rugged landscapes. The scene depicts muscular figures in a chaotic tumble among jagged rocks. A celestial figure emerges from swirling clouds, directing the scene below with an outstretched arm while holding a lightning bolt. The composition is dense and dynamic, creating a sense of motion and tension. The monochrome palette enhances the dramatic tone, and the intricate line work adds depth and texture, suggesting a narrative rooted in classical mythology.

artworks.title: Mother with Two Children  and a Horse in Front of an Inn
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of animals and figures near an archway in a rustic setting. The image shows two horses, one with a rider in armor and the other saddled, near a seated group of figures consisting of a woman holding a child, and another child interacting with a dog. The scene takes place in a shaded area near a building with a window, and the background suggests rugged terrain with a rocky archway leading to a farther landscape where additional figures and animals are visible. The use of shading and contrasting elements captures a sense of depth and atmosphere, reflecting both the calm and movement within the scene.

artworks.title: Two Fighting Horsemen
artworks.description: The image features a battlefield scene with two mounted figures in armor engaged in a dynamic gesture. They are surrounded by other combatants on foot and horseback. The scene includes a fallen figure, lush foliage in the foreground, and dark clouds swirling in the background. The style is reminiscent of Peter Paul Rubens or Baroque artists, characterized by dramatic light use and dynamic movement.

artworks.title: Robbers on Horseback
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene with horses and figures. The image shows an interaction between several figures and two horses within a pastoral setting. In the foreground, two individuals are seated on the ground, accompanied by a small child. Nearby, a figure atop a horse reaches towards another figure who leads a laden horse. A dog is present, standing alert at the horse's hooves. The backdrop showcases lush trees and distant hills, suggesting a serene countryside environment. The attention to detail and shading creates a realistic depiction of this rustic scene.

artworks.title: A General on Horseback (Charles of Lorraine)
artworks.description: The image depicts a battle scene with soldiers on horseback. The central figure is a horseman in armor raising a sword amidst the combat. The scene shows horses rearing, soldiers clashing, and structures engulfed in smoke in the background. The artwork is detailed and richly textured, capturing the intensity of the battle. The style is reminiscent of Peter Paul Rubens, known for dynamic compositions and dramatic scenes.

artworks.title: A Horseman Shooting a Turk from His Horse
artworks.description: This image shows a battle scene with mounted figures engaged in combat. Horses are rearing and fighters are armed with various weapons. The central figure on horseback is wielding a gun with smoke around them. Other figures are also shown in battle, and there are fallen figures and weapons on the ground. The scene is detailed with a focus on action and posture.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius, after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image shows a man with outstretched arms, nailed to a wooden cross. His head is tilted upwards, and his expression appears tense. He has long, tousled hair, exposed upper body with defined muscles, and a piece of fabric around his waist. A board above his head displays inscriptions in multiple languages. Surrounding him are swirling clouds, angelic figures, and a skull-faced figure holding a crescent to the left. The background features a hilly landscape with buildings and a cityscape.

artworks.title: Mars and Venus Surprised by Vulcan
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical interior scene featuring draped fabric and intricate detailing. The drawing depicts an interior space with a large, ornately decorated bed covered with luxurious drapery and bedding. In the foreground, a large, elaborately designed amphora and a smaller jug are placed on a rectangular bedside table, which stands on a textured floor. The background shows heavy curtains framing the scene. The overall style of the drawing suggests an emphasis on texture and form, likely executed with techniques such as cross-hatching to create a rich, detailed look.

artworks.title: Dance of the Dryades
artworks.artist: Probably French 16th Century after Pierre Milan after Rosso Fiorentino
artworks.description: The image depicts six draped female figures dancing in a circle beneath a tree. They are captured mid-step, holding hands, with flowing drapery. The background features bushy vegetation, a large tree, and textured elements implying an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and ink on tracing paper
artworks.description: The image features large rocks and boulders with some vegetation, depicted in an ink drawing style with quick, expressive lines and cross-hatching. The color palette is black ink on a beige or light brown paper. The composition suggests rocky terrain that rises and falls, providing a varied backdrop. Detailed vegetation and rocks are depicted close to the viewer, with similar formations leading up to the top edge of the image.

artworks.title: Frontispiece: Dedication to Pietro Strozzi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate, classical text page. The central focus of the drawing is an elaborate cartouche containing a block of formal text. The border surrounding the text is intricately designed with classical motifs, including swirls, vegetation, and two seated figures on either side. These figures blend into the curled shapes and ornamental flourishes that adorn the border. The detailed embellishments add a sense of grandeur and antiquity to the overall composition, and the fine lines of the drawing suggest a skilled hand.

artworks.title: Cavalry Engagement
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The drawing shows a cavalry charge in the midst of a battle. The focus is on horses galloping with armored riders. In the background, there are cavalry and foot soldiers fighting. The horses and riders are in dynamic poses, showing intensity. The drawing is detailed with textures and expressions.

artworks.title: Cavalry Attack on a Walled Fortress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The drawing depicts a chaotic and energetic battle with several figures clothed in armor and wielding weapons, mounted on horses. To the left of the image, a group appears to be engaged in combat with massive creatures, resembling elephants, amidst billowing smoke or dust. The action centers around two horsemen, prominently positioned in the foreground on the right, seemingly leading the charge, one of whom is pointing or commanding others in the fray. Behind them, a cavalry charge is visible, with flags flying and more soldiers engulfed in the turmoil of battle. The scene is crowded, energetic, and filled with intricate, swirling lines creating a sense of frenetic movement and urgency. This image is rendered in a highly detailed, intricate linework typical of historical battle depictions.

artworks.title: Battle Scene with Cavalry Observing from a Hill
artworks.description: The image shows a group of soldiers on horseback in the foreground, facing right. The horses are detailed with musculature and flowing manes. In the background, troops are seen in formation holding spears and shields, engaged in battle. The setting includes fortifications, a castle, and hills. The illustration is highly detailed, capturing a historical battle scene.

artworks.title: Battle Scene with Two Horses Attacking Each Other
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The artwork depicts a medieval battle with soldiers and horses clashing. The foreground is filled with combat, showing fallen figures and rearing horses. Details in the armor and weapons add to the realism of the scene. In the background, a fortified city with walls and gates can be seen, with figures engaged in battle approaching the city. The drawing uses contrasts and lines to convey movement and energy.

artworks.title: Cavalry Charge with Soldiers and Horses Trampled
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with armored horses and warriors. The composition features detailed figures engaged in combat. Warriors are seen clad in armor and wielding weapons, while the horses are depicted with intricate musculature and movement. This artwork is done in the style of Leonardo da Vinci.

artworks.title: Battle between Cavalry and Infantry
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with knights and horses engaged in combat. The scene features armored figures wielding swords and shields, with several horses rearing or fallen. The use of fine lines and strong contrasts adds to the intensity of the scene. The panel's composition captures the movement of a historic battle.

artworks.title: Cavalry Attack with Soldiers Fleeing
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. Numerous armored figures are engaged in combat atop horses. The composition is detailed with lances and swords creating diagonals. The muscles and expressions of the horses convey the intensity of the battle. The figures wear intricately designed armor. The drawing captures a moment in a battle, with movement and conflict. The textures and lines are finely rendered.

artworks.title: Cavalry Engagement
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with horses. The artwork shows a chaotic battlefield with numerous horses engaged in combat. The horses are depicted in dynamic poses, some rearing up and others falling. Details such as limbs, muscles, and flowing manes are rendered with intricate linework. The composition is dense, with little space between the figures, emphasizing the intensity of the clash. Contrast and shading bring depth to the scene. The drawing captures the energy and motion of a battle.

artworks.title: Cavalry Attack with Soldiers Fleeing
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a battle scene. The image shows a confrontation between mounted and foot soldiers engaged in combat with spears and swords. Some soldiers are fighting in close combat, while others are attacking or defending. A central figure on horseback is prominent in the scene. The drawing is detailed with intricate line work, capturing the movement and tension of the skirmish. The background depicts a rocky terrain, setting the scene in a battlefield environment. The composition conveys a sense of action and drama, typical of historical battle depictions.

artworks.title: Six Cavalrymen in Combat
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of horses in motion. The image depicts four horses, with one horse prominently depicted on its back. The horses are adorned with flowing manes, and their dynamic poses suggest a narrative of action. The intricate line work and attention to the musculature of the animals emphasize their power and grace. The composition is tightly packed, with the horses almost overlapping each other.

artworks.title: The Taking of Cartagena
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene surrounding a heavily fortified city. The illustration depicts warriors engaging in combat, some climbing walls with ladders, and others fighting with various weapons, including shields and spears. The setting includes stone towers and walls, trees on the left, and battling groups extending into the background. Banners and the positioning of the warriors add to the dramatic tension of the scene, highlighting the chaos of sieges during warfare.

artworks.title: Young Peasant Seated on the Ground [recto]
artworks.medium: red chalk with touches of white heightening on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 34.2 x 26.8 cm (13 7/16 x 10 9/16 in.)
support: 47.6 x 37.8 cm (18 3/4 x 14 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person in a crouching position, depicted from head to toe. The individual's head is slightly tilted with their eyes looking forward. They have short, smooth hair and a detailed face. They are dressed in a loose-fitting, long-sleeved shirt. The drawing emphasizes the muscles and contours of the limbs, particularly the forearm and leg. One arm is extended outward with the hand facing up. The background is plain with a textured paper surface.

artworks.title: River Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with blue and brown wash on  laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 25.2 x 39.2 cm (9 15/16 x 15 7/16 in.)
support: 35.2 x 49.5 cm (13 7/8 x 19 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with mountains, hills, a river, a bridge, people, animals, and buildings.
